title: Good Local News Panel
description:
Despite the serious headwinds that the local news business is facing, there are many excellent state and local news outlets. 

**This panel will highlight four exceptional news organizations** that are prospering and finding new ways to cover their states, cities and towns — doing better than ever covering the diverse communities they serve. Their editors-in-chief will discuss what they are doing to connect to their communities and to cover the news in these difficult times.

Local news is a vital resource. Local journalists alert us to dangers, root out waste, and strengthen our communities. On top of all that, they make us better citizens. Studies show that civic engagement increases where local news is strong — more people vote.

Local news is particularly crucial in these difficult times. Among other things, the panelists will discuss how they are assessing the impacts of the MAGA cuts and how they are covering the growing movement to defend our democracy.

This event is co-hosted by the [Media and Democracy Project](https://www.mediaanddemocracyproject.org/journalism-directory) and [Markers For Democracy](https://markersfordemocracy.org/).
